correctness.rationale: The local condition at a degree-three cycle vertex has exactly two possibilities (all three neighbor colors equal or pairwise distinct), giving leaf multiplicities 1 and k-3. The trace on directed color arcs follows bijectively. Its invariant decomposition has multiplicities 1, 2(k-1), k(k-3)/2, and (k-1)(k-2)/2, summing to k(k-1); the 2x2 block has trace recurrence U_j. Polynomial extension covers k=0,1,2. For odd cycles, the distance-two equality graph excludes fewer than three defects; sign-walk counting proves exact leading coefficient n(n^2-1)/4. Direct enumeration of 1,185,894 vertex colorings, 224 separate transfer evaluations, six odd defect counts, and parity boundary checks all passed from the supplied verifier.

value.rationale: The all-palette strong-odd coloring polynomial is a natural graph-coloring enumerator of a canonical unicyclic family; prior literature mostly supplies scalar bounds. A fixed order-five length recurrence replaces exponentially many vertex assignments. The exact order-three zero at palette size three quantifies a nontrivial obstruction, while the parity 2-versus-4 threshold and exact multiplicities distinguish optimal configurations. These are structural and enumerative results, not arbitrary finite cuts or a bare repetition of the known unicyclic four-color bound.
